content:
Maya: Quick sync — MediClinic (Monica) needs enterprise commit sizing for clinical-triage PoC. Peak: 900 RPS for ~10m/day, sustained 500 RPS business hours. Avg seq ~120, model: 2k-context gen. Need reserved GPU proposal, burst plan, preheat and KV-warm strategy, plus smoke-test plan for execs.
Frank: I'll own sizing. Are embeddings routed separately?
Monica: Same service, embeddings ~20% of calls. Tokens/day estimate ~600M. 95p target <350ms.
Kevin: Ballpark: A100-class GPU for 2k-context at 120 tokens ~350 RPS with good batching/KV hits. For 900 RPS spikes I'd suggest reserved 6 GPUs (4 baseline + 2 hot), burst credits for spike delta, AZ spread (min 2 AZs).
Frank: Propose three tiers:
- Low: reserved 4 GPUs, burst pool 500M tokens/mo, autoscale min=3
- Mid: reserved 6 GPUs, burst pool 1.2B tokens/mo, autoscale min=4
- High: reserved 8 GPUs, burst pool 2B tokens/mo, autoscale min=6
Kevin: Ops notes: preheat 20-30m before business hours, kv-prefill by replaying last 30m traffic, health-check pinned to fallback model. Use quantized 8-bit fallback for spot/backfill.
Monica: Finance wants math for reserved vs burst cost. Can you show assumptions?
Frank: Example calc (Mid): spike tokens = 900 * 120 * 600s * 30 = ~1.94B tokens/month. Baseline tokens (500 RPS business hours) ~345M. We'll show how much of that reserved GPUs cover and map remainder to burst credits and $ cost.
Kevin: Smoke-test plan: three runs — baseline 500 RPS 30m, spike 900 RPS 10m inside 30m, soak 300 RPS 4h. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, KV hit rate, token usage. Example command:
```bash
redwood-load --target https://staging.redwood/medic-triage --rps 900 --duration 600 --seq 120 --track p95,p99,gpu_util,kv_hit
```
ops-bot: Preheat job scheduled: staging/kv-prefill v2.1 by kevin.
legal-bot: Sent contract snippet for 3yr audit retention and KMS clause.
Maya: Action items: Frank -> SOW appendix with three tiers + cost math by EOD tomorrow. Kevin -> ops runbook + preheat job and smoke-test harness. Monica -> upload sample traffic CSV. Legal-bot -> DPA & audit clause.
Monica: Uploading CSV now. Thanks team.
Frank: Acknowledged, starting numbers.
Maya: Perfect, talk soon :thumbsup:
